game.title: Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu!
game.notes: Migrated from Chaty Trophy System v1.0. Trophy design carries over unchanged; names were translated to English and verification fields were added new. Those verification claims have not been audited yet — run the pantheon-auditor before marking this approved. Shiny hunting, max AVs, all TMs, all Coach Trainers and all Master Trainers were deliberately excluded as grinding (Rules 10 and 20).

trophies.name: Show Me What You've Got
trophies.description: Defeat your first Coach Trainer.
trophies.verification: Defeated Coach Trainers stop offering a rematch prompt and no longer show the challenge marker.

trophies.name: Super Effective!
trophies.description: Earn your first Gym Badge.
trophies.verification: Badge displayed on the Trainer Card.

trophies.name: Right on the Mark
trophies.description: Catch a Pokémon with an Excellent Throw.
trophies.verification: The catch screen displays the Excellent Throw bonus before the capture result.

trophies.name: Don't Break the Chain
trophies.description: Reach a Catch Combo of 31 with a single Pokémon species.
trophies.verification: The combo counter is shown on the catch screen with every successful capture.

trophies.name: Partners in the Journey
trophies.description: Learn all five Secret Techniques with your partner Pikachu.
trophies.verification: Known Secret Techniques are listed in the partner menu.

trophies.name: Kanto Archaeologist
trophies.description: Register Omanyte, Kabuto and Aerodactyl in the Pokédex.
trophies.verification: Caught marks on the three Pokédex entries.

trophies.name: Double Trouble
trophies.description: Defeat Jessie and James at Silph Co.
trophies.verification: Story progresses past the Silph Co. encounter.

trophies.name: The Fall of Team Rocket
trophies.description: Defeat Giovanni at the Viridian Gym and earn the Earth Badge.
trophies.verification: Earth Badge displayed on the Trainer Card.

trophies.name: Legendary Wings
trophies.description: Catch Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres.
trophies.verification: Caught marks on the three Pokédex entries.

trophies.name: Master of Kanto
trophies.description: Earn all eight Gym Badges.
trophies.verification: All eight badges displayed on the Trainer Card.

trophies.name: Hall of Fame
trophies.description: Defeat the Elite Four and become Champion of the Pokémon League.
trophies.verification: Team registered in the Hall of Fame record.

trophies.name: Beyond the Limit
trophies.description: Perform your first Mega Evolution.
trophies.verification: The Mega Evolution option activates in battle for a Pokémon holding its Mega Stone.
trophies.notes: Verification needs confirmation — check whether the Pokédex records Mega forms, which would give a persistent record instead of a one-off battle event (Rule 1).

trophies.name: A Pokémon from Another World
trophies.description: Catch Mewtwo in Cerulean Cave.
trophies.verification: Caught mark on the Mewtwo Pokédex entry.

trophies.name: She Was Waiting for You
trophies.description: Defeat Green after catching Mewtwo.
trophies.verification: The encounter at Cerulean Cave does not repeat once completed.

trophies.name: The New Viridian Leader
trophies.description: Defeat Blue at the Viridian Gym after becoming Champion.
trophies.verification: The Viridian Gym rematch is completed and no longer available that day.

trophies.name: The League Strikes Back
trophies.description: Defeat the strengthened Elite Four after becoming Champion.
trophies.verification: A second Hall of Fame entry is recorded.

trophies.name: Pokémon Specialist
trophies.description: Earn your first Master Trainer title.
trophies.verification: The Master Trainer title appears next to that Pokémon in your party and boxes.

trophies.name: Among the Masters
trophies.description: Earn six Master Trainer titles and make Red appear at Indigo Plateau.
trophies.verification: Titles visible on six Pokémon, and Red appears at Indigo Plateau.

trophies.name: The Legend of Kanto
trophies.description: Defeat Red at Indigo Plateau.
trophies.verification: Red no longer offers the battle once defeated.

trophies.name: Bonds Between Trainers
trophies.description: Trade a Pokémon with another trainer.
trophies.verification: The received Pokémon shows a different original trainer in its summary.

trophies.name: The Other Side of Kanto
trophies.description: Register a Pokémon exclusive to Let's Go, Eevee! in the Pokédex.
trophies.verification: Caught mark on the version-exclusive Pokédex entry.

trophies.name: Pokémon Master Diploma
trophies.description: Complete the Kanto Pokédex with the 150 required species and receive the diploma.
trophies.verification: Pokédex completion counter reaches 150, and the diploma is awarded at the Game Freak office in Celadon City.
trophies.notes: Official completion requires 150 species, Bulbasaur through Mewtwo. Mew, Meltan and Melmetal are not needed. Requires trading or transfer for species unavailable in Let's Go, Pikachu! and for trade evolutions.

trophies.name: An Unforgettable Journey
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.
trophies.verification: All 22 other trophies earned.
